_comment: The chips on a book's page under "What you'll find inside". A chip is a claim, so each one carries the words of the book's own record (its description, subtitle or ideal-reader line in scripts/catalog/valice-catalog.mjs) that make it; book-highlights.test.ts fails if the evidence is not there. Nothing here is a genre convention nobody wrote down.
